hypotheses.why_missing_from_catalogues: Rapid Holocene alluvial-fan aggradation, eolian/playa cover, and hydrothermal silica/carbonate self-sealing obscure <1.5 m surface scarps over >75% of blind Great Basin geothermal conduits.
